## Page 9

AMATA’s partnership with “ DayOne Data Centers”
▪AMATA signed MOU with DayOne Data Centers , a Singapore -
headquartered company who develops and operates digital 
infrastructure and data centers , to support its future development of 
Chonburi Tech Park 2 (CTP2), and the expansion of Chonburi Tech Park 1 
(CTP1) which will add 41 Rai to the adjacent 72 Rai in CPT1.
▪CTP1&2 will create the first 1GW power platform in Thailand and 
one of the largest digital -infrastructure campus in Southeast Asia.
▪The deal is also complemented by a renewable -energy agreement with 
Amata B.Grimm Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. (AMBRE) to supply clean 
power to its facilities via Private Power Purchase Agreement (Private PPA) of 
42.5 MW, signed in the same ceremony.
9
About AMBRE :
Amata B.Grimm Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. (AMBRE) is a Thailand -based 
JV between Amata U (75%) and B.Grimm Power Smart Solutions (25%), established 
to develop, generate, distribute, and sell solar energy. The first green field project of 
AMBRE is the floating solar project on the reservoirs in AMATA City Chonburi with 
estimated capacity of 42.5MW and target COD in 2027Nov 2025 : Signing ceremony between DayOne Data Centers and AMATA
